name: Katya Aurélie
japaneseName: カチュア・オーレリー
description: Katya Aurélie is a noblewoman of the Sacred Vollachia Empire, the younger sister of Jamal Aurélie, and the wife of Todd Fang. Despite suffering from chronic illness and physical disability, she displays a fierce, sharp-witted resilience, playing a prominent supporting role across Arc 7 and Arc 8.
